item.text: I’ll trace the existing configuration types, defaults, loaders, and validation, then add the metadata option in the same style and run the relevant existing tests. I’ll also write the required checkpoint file early.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p .codex-role-output && cat > .codex-role-output/checkpoint.md <<'EOF'
# Checkpoint

Task: add application metadata configuration, including a startup version-check preference defaulting to enabled, with JSON/YAML loading and existing validation integration.

Initial status: repository inspection is in progress. No source files have been changed yet.
EOF
find .. -name AGENTS.md -print; find . -maxdepth 3 -type f \\( -name '*config*' -o -name '*Config*' -o -name 'go.mod' -o -name 'Cargo.toml' -o -name 'package.json' \\) -print | head -200"
